import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_test_2.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_sample_submission_2.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission head:\n{sample_submission.head()}")


# Create id column for test set
def create_ids(df):
    df["id"] = df["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + df["token_id"].astype(str)
    return df


test = create_ids(test.copy())

# Vectorize both before and after for token-level similarity matching
# Strategy: For each test token, find the most similar training token by TF-IDF features
vectorizer_before = TfidfVectorizer(
    token_pattern=r"[\w]|\d", lower=True, ngram_range=(1, 1)
)
vectorizer_after = TfidfVectorizer(
    token_pattern=r"[\w]|\d", lower=True, ngram_range=(1, 1)
)

# Prepare training features
train_before_vec = vectorizer_before.fit_transform(train["before"])
train_after_vec = vectorizer_after.fit_transform(train["after"])

# Transform test data
test_before_vec = vectorizer_before.transform(test["before"])

# Predict by finding nearest neighbors in feature space
from scipy.sparse import hstack

combined_test = hstack([test_before_vec, train_before_vec])

# Compute cosine similarity between test and training embeddings
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

sim_scores = cosine_similarity(test_before_vec.T, train_before_vec).reshape(
    len(test), -1
)

# Get the index of the highest scoring training token for each test instance
best_indices = np.argmax(sim_scores, axis=1)

# Get corresponding "after" predictions
predictions_df = pd.DataFrame()
predictions_df["id"] = test["id"]
predictions_df["after"] = []

for idx, best_idx in enumerate(best_indices):
    predictions_df["after"].append(train.iloc[best_idx]["after"])

predictions = predictions_df.reset_index(drop=True)

# Calculate accuracy against validation split
# Hold out 10% of training data that never gets used
val_size = int(len(train) * 0.1)
train_val_split = train.tail(val_size).copy()

# Reconstruct hold-out split without leakage
holdout_mask = np.zeros(len(train), dtype=bool)
holdout_mask[-val_size:] = True

# Remove holdout from training for evaluation
train_no_holdout = train.iloc[: len(train) - val_size].copy()

# Re-vectorize excluding holdout
vectorizer_before_no_val = TfidfVectorizer(
    token_pattern=r"[\w]|\d", lower=True, ngram_range=(1, 1)
)
vectorizer_after_no_val = TfidfVectorizer(
    token_pattern=r"[\w]|\d", lower=True, ngram_range=(1, 1)
)

train_no_val_before_vec = vectorizer_before_no_val.fit_transform(
    train_no_val_holdout["before"]
)
train_no_val_after_vec = vectorizer_after_no_val.fit_transform(
    train_no_val_holdout["after"]
)

train_no_val_before_vec_nocopy = vectorizer_before_no_val.transform(
    train_no_val_holdout["before"]
)
train_no_val_after_vec_nocopy = vectorizer_after_no_val.transform(
    train_no_val_holdout["after"]
)

# Actually simpler approach - use holdout directly for evaluation
# Split the entire dataset once
train_features = train[["before"]].copy()
train_targets = train[["after"]].copy()

train_X, eval_X, train_y, eval_y = train_test_split(
    train_features,
    train_targets,
    test_size=val_size,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train["class"],
)

# Refit models excluding validation
final_vectorizer_before = TfidfVectorizer(
    token_pattern=r"[\w]|\d", lower=True, ngram_range=(1, 1)
)
final_vectorizer_after = TfidfVectorizer(
    token_pattern=r"[\w]|\d", lower=True, ngram_range=(1, 1)
)

train_X_vec = final_vectorizer_before.fit_transform(train_X)
train_y_vec = final_vectorizer_after.fit_transform(eval_y)

eval_X_vec = final_vectorizer_before.transform(eval_X)

# Evaluate on held-out set
eval_sim = cosine_similarity(eval_X_vec.T, train_X_vec).reshape(len(eval_X), -1)
eval_best_indices = np.argmax(eval_sim, axis=1)
eval_predictions = [train_y.iloc[i] for i in eval_best_indices]
eval_accuracy = sum(
    pred == actual
    for pred, actual in zip(eval_predictions, eval_y.iloc[:, :].values.flatten())
) / len(eval_y)

# Save predictions to submission file
os.makedirs("./submission/", exist_ok=True)
predictions.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Hold-out validation accuracy: {eval_accuracy:.6f}")
